name: zcode-switchman
description: Fixed six-lane sub-agent fleet for ZCode: shells self-provision at session start (bodies auto-sync; the user-owned `model:`/`thoughtLevel:` lines pass through every sync verbatim — never rewritten, dropped, or injected; only creation writes the built-in `model: inherit`), a failure breaker, a shell context guard (absolute-k tiers, once-per-tier advisories, HANDOFF relay), a per-project language preference (first-run ask → [LANG] iron rule), and read-only bash for ro shells (git diff/log/show-class inspection behind a hook-enforced view/search allowlist; writes denied). Ships three companion skills: git-commit-message, requirement-docs, db-query (read-only MySQL/Redis), a token-economy routing rule (per-turn [ROUTE] iron rule: state self-vs-dispatch in one sentence and weigh context length; banner [Rule] line; opt out via settings), and a code-comment format iron rule (per-turn [COMMENT] line + banner [Comment] line: every code comment follows [yyyy-mm-dd]-[why]-[impact]; opt out via settings), and a hint-only DB advisory (a [DB] line when the user prompt or a Bash command looks database-related: prefer the db-query skill; never blocks; opt out via settings).

description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 固定六档子代理编队：会话启动自动装配六壳（正文自动同步；`model:`/`thoughtLevel:` 两行为用户私产，每次同步原样透传——绝不改写、丢弃或凭空注入，仅创建时写入内置 `model: inherit`）；失败熔断、壳上下文守卫（绝对 k 三档、每档一次、HANDOFF 接力）、项目级语言偏好（首启三问 → [LANG] 铁律），以及 ro 壳的只读 Bash（hook 强制的查看/搜索白名单放行 git diff/log/show 类操作，写入一律拒绝）。随插件附带三个技能：git-commit-message、requirement-docs、db-query（只读 MySQL/Redis 核验）、token 账派发纪律（每轮 [ROUTE] 铁律：动手前一句话权衡自己做还是派、并考虑上下文长度；横幅 [Rule] 行，设置可关），以及代码注释格式铁律（每轮 [COMMENT] 行 + 横幅 [Comment] 行：所有代码注释按 [yyyy-mm-dd]-[why]-[impact] 书写；设置可关），以及只提示不拦截的 DB 引导（提示词或 Bash 命令像查库时注入 [DB] 行：优先用 db-query 技能；绝不拦截；设置可关）。
